notes.design: floored(cur, height, rise) raises extra to (rise - line * height).min(0): the line sits at or below the column's first baseline and its box at or below the column top (rise = inset_top + ascent - first for a frame-top column, 0 in a band); applied at the Single gap (before the anchored push), in next_slot for every slot, and in balance_band per row; baseline_of returns max(baseline, base) against rounding. vertical_justify measures the block from the highest line top to the deepest line bottom (review F1).
